description: Test suite for the execute handler in a Gin-based web server, testing execution flow and error handling for various scenarios.

methods.name: TestExecuteHandler_Success
methods.description: Tests successful execution flow including HTTP request to agent, response processing, and storage update.

methods.name: TestExecuteHandler_AgentError
methods.description: Tests handling of an agent returning HTTP 500 error, verifying error propagation and record update.

methods.name: TestExecuteHandler_TargetNotFound
methods.description: Tests the case where the target specified in the request does not exist, expecting a 400 error.

methods.name: TestExecuteAsyncHandler_ReturnsAccepted
methods.description: Tests asynchronous execution initiation, expecting an accepted response and eventual completion.

methods.name: TestExecuteAsyncHandler_InvalidJSON
methods.description: Tests handling of invalid JSON payloads for async execution requests.

methods.name: TestGetExecutionStatusHandler_ReturnsResult
methods.description: Verifies correctness of retrieving execution status and result by ID.

methods.name: TestBatchExecutionStatusHandler_MixedResults
methods.description: Tests batch status retrieval with some executions found and some missing.
